sentences: Since it checks every pair from start to end, the biggest number moves to the last spot.
The swap puts smaller numbers before bigger ones each time, so the array ends up in order.
After the loop goes through all three elements once, everything must be sorted by then.
The loop compares each neighbour and fixes them, so one full pass is enough to sort it.
Because j goes from 0 to n-1, every element gets compared and the array becomes sorted.
